title: Tanshinone IIA derivatives inhibits colorectal cancer growth by targeting pyruvate kinase M2.
authors: Bai, Jing; Liu, Shengli; Mang, Zhiguo; Duan, Xueqing; Song, Changfeng; Tian, Weiyi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究丹参酮IIA衍生物靶向PKM2抑制结直肠癌，涉及小分子-蛋白互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA体系无关。
abstract: Pyruvate kinase M2 (PKM2), a key glycolytic enzyme, is frequently overexpressed in colorectal cancer (CRC) and has emerged as a promising therapeutic target. In this study, a series of Tanshinone IIA derivatives were designed and synthesized through simultaneous modification of rings A and D, and their anti-CRC activities were evaluated. The optimized derivative 23 exhibited PKM2 activation (AC(50) = 92.12 nM) and significantly inhibited the proliferation of CRC cells. Molecular docking analysis revealed that the piperidinothiophene moiety in 23 strengthens binding through a salt bridge interaction with Asp295. Furthermore, 23 suppressed the PKM2/STAT3 signaling pathway both in vitro and in vivo. Together, these findings highlight derivative 23 as a promising anticancer candidate for the treatment of CRC.
abstract_zh: 丙酮酸激酶M2（PKM2）是一种关键的糖酵解酶，在结直肠癌（CRC）中经常过表达，并已成为一个有前景的治疗靶点。在本研究中，通过同时修饰A环和D环，设计并合成了一系列丹参酮IIA衍生物，并评估了其抗CRC活性。优化后的衍生物23表现出PKM2激活作用（AC(50) = 92.12 nM），并显著抑制CRC细胞的增殖。分子对接分析显示，23中的哌啶并噻吩部分通过盐桥相互作用与Asp295增强结合。此外，23在体外和体内均抑制了PKM2/STAT3信号通路。综合这些发现，衍生物23被强调为治疗CRC的有前景的抗癌候选药物。
